description: POST request whose signature additionally covers @authority (OPTIONAL, RECOMMENDED per v1.6.0 §4.2). The component value is the lowercased target host, ordered between @method and @path. A verifier reconstructs the value from its own configured authority or the request's Host header — a verifier serving any other host computes a different signature base and the signature fails, closing the cross-host relay window. Same body and keypair as vec-2.

inputs.body_serialization: JSON.stringify with no spaces — the exact bytes the Content-Digest covers

expected.verifier_note: Verifies only when the verifier's own authority is receiver.example.com. A verifier at evil.example.com reconstructs "@authority": evil.example.com and MUST fail signature verification.
